Verified map, all read in code. Paths are relative to HB=external/holtburger/apps/holtburger-web unless given in full. PW = /home/wbterminal/.npm/_npx/e41f203b7505f1fb/node_modules.

Q1. How scripts connect to Chrome
- Every in-repo driver uses Playwright. No in-repo script speaks raw CDP over its own WebSocket.
- playwright and playwright-core 1.59.1 exist only in the npx cache PW. HB/package.json devDeps are only three, postprocessing and takram.
- HB/node_modules/playwright-core is a symlink into PW. So an ESM `import {chromium} from "playwright-core"` only resolves for scripts under apps/holtburger-web (vistest-1070-round1-7.mjs:25, moving-bench.mjs:449, flag-census/bootab.mjs:9). ESM ignores NODE_PATH (fleet-runbooks:49).
- Scripts elsewhere load it differently:
  - createRequire with the absolute PW path: scripts/perf-worker/hbprobe.mjs:15, coldboot/*.mjs, flag-bench.mjs (env PLAYWRIGHT_CORE).
  - Absolute ESM import: cmdinterp-1070.mjs:5.
  - CJS `require("playwright")` with a PLAYWRIGHT_CACHE fallback: capture_canvas_video.cjs:18-24. harness/lib/boot.mjs loadChromium() (:90-111) also falls back to playwright-core.
- Two connection modes exist:
  - **launch (laptop):** boot.mjs:203-227 starts headless `--use-gl=swiftshader` with anti-throttle flags and `--enable-precise-memory-info`, viewport 1280x1024, holding heavy_lock until close.
  - **connectOverCDP('http://127.0.0.1:9333') (1070):** reached through `ssh -fN -L 9333:127.0.0.1:9333 young@100.127.215.75`.
- Raw-CDP clients existed only in session scratchpads (cdp_eval.cjs/.py: GET /json → page ws → Runtime.evaluate awaitPromise, per memory stream-soak-runbook.md:21). Node v20.20.2 has no global WebSocket unless run with --experimental-websocket (checked); fetch is global.
- Raw CDP inside the repo goes through `ctx.newCDPSession(page)`: Profiler in hbprobe.mjs:280, Page.startScreencast in scripts/visual-regression/capture-all.cjs:337.
- Reusable connection layers:
  - **scripts/perf-worker/coldboot/pw1070/playwright.js.** Used with NODE_PATH=that dir. Its `chromium.launch()` runs gate1070.sh, ensures the -L 9333 tunnel, starts a fresh-profile test Chrome via the schtasks 'hbprobe' task, then connectOverCDP. It rewrites http://127.0.0.1:8765 to the laptop tailnet front http://100.116.47.66:7080 (scripts/proxy.cjs: serve.py plus /wsbridge) and adds bridge_url/server_host/server_port/nosw. close() closes only its own pages.
  - **coldboot/sess.mjs** boots a persistent session. Separate tiny clients then drive it: probe.mjs, shot.mjs, camset.mjs, teleshot.mjs, enterchar.mjs, click.mjs. Each finds the page by url.includes('holtburger-web').
- Box launch is box/hbprobe-launch.bat:10:

Window size comes from winsize.txt (default 1280,720).
  - It must run in the INTERACTIVE session via schtasks /it; SSH-launched Chrome has no GL.
  - hbgate.ps1 refuses to launch while a person is present. Cleanup is hbbench-kill.ps1, which matches the profile dir only.

Q2. Boot recipe
- Canonical URLs:
  - moving-bench buildUrl (:198-210): `index.html?nosw=1&quality=mid&adaptiveRes=off&renderScale=1&renderDiag=on&camDebug=on&vfxGauge=on&autoLogin=1&account=A&password=A&autoSpawn=first&agent=1[&renderOnDemand=1&netDrainHz=30]`.
  - hbprobe :222 is similar, with camDebug=on and adaptiveRes=off.
  - sess.mjs:29 goes through the relay/front with `bridge_url=ws://100.116.47.66:7093/wsbridge&server_host=127.0.0.1&server_port=9000`.
- agent=1 or autoLogin=1 adds html.agent-mode (index.html:611), and the canvas fills the viewport (CSS :456-516).
- Since 2026-10-05, `hb-*` HUD roots are EXEMPT from agent-mode hiding (:474-484). Only `?hud=none` (:614, CSS :527-539) strips them. hud=none also forces sprite nameplates off; they are default OFF anyway (scene3d/nameplate_sprite.js:311-320).
- Boot state machine (index.html:4265-4281):
  - Surfaces: `__bootState`, `__bootStateHistory` as [{state,message,ts}], a `holtburger:state` CustomEvent, and console `[boot-state] X`.
  - Order: init → form-shown → connecting → kicking → reconnecting → char-list-ready → spawning → in-world.
  - 'ready' means the atmosphere composer is wired (scene3d/index.js:6288-6292; the wire-agent variants are at :5800 and :7694). It can arrive before or after in-world. `__sceneReadyEverFired` latches it.
- Gates in use:
  - **boot.mjs (nullRender protocol only):** in-world (scalar or history) plus getLocalPlayerPose()!=null; never gates on 'ready'.
  - **vistest:** waits for 'ready' (atmosphere and `__set*` helpers attach after in-world), then 8 s.
  - **moving-bench classifyBoot (:246-266):** go on in-world, ready or sceneReadyEverFired. A later ready-watchdog 'error' is ignored. A pre-in-world error triggers `window.__runAutonomousLogin({autoSpawn:'first',maxRetries:1})` after a 9 s cooldown. Defaults in app/auto_login.js:87-130 are maxRetries 0, connect 25 s, spawn 20 s.
  - **sess.mjs:35-43:** liveScene3d && __sessionHandle && __sceneReadyEverFired && terrainBakedLbs.size>=9, then `__isPortalSpaceActive()===false`. The login tunnel can hide the world AFTER in-world; it is skipped by agent=1, bot, nullRender, renderOnDemand, wireframe, loginPortalSpace=off and portalSpace=off (scene3d/portal_space.js:187-205).
  - **cmdinterp:** in-world or ready, then scene mesh count >100.
- Settle check: hbprobe settle() waits until `__landblockLru.entries.size|renderer.info.memory.geometries` is unchanged for 12 s.
- Measured on the 1070, 2026-10-06, mid, fresh profile: boot to ready 8.4-11.2 s. The settle after `@teleloc Holtburg` took 98.6 s (flagbench-r1 summary).
- window.liveScene3d is assigned at the end of init3D (scene3d/index.js:4420); poll for non-null.
- Accounts:
  - tailnet1 is Developer, but on the 1070 it is the HUMAN's account; moving-bench.mjs:111 says use a bot such as agentp07.
  - phase4demo is the spare.
  - Passwords: see the repo harness scripts (deliberately not copied here).
- Single-login gaps in use:
  - 26 s (vistest:151).
  - 65 s after an abrupt close (boot.mjs:49-61: the WS↔UDP bridge never says goodbye, so ACE waits for its 60 s network-timeout reap).
  - 90-100 s (cmdinterp).
  - Tailing ACE_Log.txt for `[LOGOUT] Account X` (hbprobe:60-79).
- Since 2026-10-09, `SessionHandle.disconnect()` sends DISCONNECT 0x8000 so a reload can log straight back in. The pagehide handler (index.html:4369-4385) does it best-effort; call it explicitly and wait about 400 ms.

Q3. Recording
- The renderer is created at scene3d/index.js:1159-1163: `new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas, antialias: q.antialias && (wireframe||canvasMsaa), logarithmicDepthBuffer:true})`. So preserveDrawingBuffer is false; no override exists anywhere in scene3d.
- The final image IS drawn to the default framebuffer: with the composer active, the canvas receives only fullscreen quads (:1131-1136). Per frame:
  1. atmospherePipeline.render(cam,dt): pmndrs EffectComposer, HalfFloat render targets plus MSAA, last pass to screen (atmosphere_pipeline.js:939-969, 2131-2163).
  2. cloudOverlay.renderOverlay: setRenderTarget(null) then render.
  3. renderPortalSpaceOverlay (index.js:2763-2788).
- Before 'ready' (atmosphere bake about 8 s on the 1070), or with atmosphere=off or wireframe, the direct path renders a different look (:2795-2811).
- **capture_canvas_video.cjs is the only recorder, and it is stale:**
  - It records captureStream(30) into MediaRecorder (vp9 → vp8 → webm fallback, 8 Mbps, 1 s timeslice) collecting `window.__recChunks` (:216-282).
  - It exports through an `<a download>` blob click, `page.waitForEvent('download')` and `dl.saveAs` (:314-327), because big blobs don't fit through evaluate.
  - It logs in through the form and pins/hides the DOM.
  - It runs `setInterval(renderer.render(scene,cam),33)`, which BYPASSES the composer (wrong look, flicker).
  - It pitches the camera with lookAt straight up, which is degenerate.
  - It must run headed (headless gave a blank 77 KB webm), and it notes that an off-screen canvas produces empty captureStream frames.
- **Proven HUD-free still frame (shot/camset/teleshot/academy/townnet):** wrap liveScene3d.renderer.render; after each call where getRenderTarget()===null, call canvas.toDataURL inside the same task. Resolve after 3 rAFs or 4 s, then restore. Cost on the 1070 is 20-60 ms of main thread per 1280x633 JPEG (academy.mjs:13-14); a 1280x633 PNG is about 0.95 MB.
- **page.screenshot (Page.captureScreenshot) is unreliable for WebGL.** It returned a stale near-black frame for over 10 min on the 1070 (capture-all.cjs:310-335), and was black on the T4. It also includes DOM HUD.
- **Page.startScreencast** (png, everyNthFrame:1, ack each frame; capture-all.cjs:337-364) returns presented frames. It includes the DOM, is base64 and is not deterministic: good for preview only.
- **Stepping already exists:**
  - ?renderOnDemand=1 (index.js:972-985) makes scheduleNext return without re-arming (:2407).
  - `window.__renderOnce()` calls tick(performance.now()) (:3007-3017).
  - moving_rig.step() (:176-187) calls __renderOnce, awaits a rAF, then up to 3 more rAFs until `__diag.vfxGauge.frames` moves. This is needed because ?syncPhysicsTick is DEFAULT ON (index.js:1091-1097, `!== "off"`), which makes tick async, so __renderOnce returns before the frame renders (:3002-3006).
  - Pair it with ?netDrainHz=30, a setInterval tickPerFrame that keeps net, PVS, streaming and entity drain running (:3031-3067). Without netDrainHz, the 2D loop stays the net driver (:1031-1035).
- CDP base64 throughput over the 1070 tunnel has never been measured.

Q4. Determinism
- **No fixed-dt, timescale or freeze hook exists.** There is no Emulation.setVirtualTimePolicy or beginFrame usage anywhere.
- dt is min((ts-lastFrameTs)/1000, 0.1) (:2497-2512). dt-recovery is disabled under renderOnDemand (:2337-2339). So a stepped frame that takes more than 100 ms advances sim 0.1 s, about 3x too fast for 30 fps output.
- **Clocks that must be virtualized:**
  - performance.now:
    - tick and __renderOnce.
    - The RP3 throttle clock (loop.js:2828-2843).
    - The particle default clock (particles/time_rng.js:15-21).
    - animated_scenery _nowMs.
    - moons tick(ts).
    - skytime=accel.
  - Date.now: the legacy sky date.
  - rAF timestamps, plus the PRIVATE rAF loops that keep running in wall time while stepped:
    - statics.js `_bbLoop` billboards (:4637-4647), which also causes a 1-frame billboard lag.
    - statics.js `_spLoop` static particles (:5768-5781; only when particleClock=off).
    - animated_scenery `_ensureRaf` (:1205-1288, wall-clock dt clamped to 0.1).
    - play_effect_vfx bursts, spell_shape_preview, nameplate LOD, speech-bubble fade.
  - **wasm:** web_time::Instant goes through the glue as `arg0.now()` on globalThis.performance and as `Date.now()` (pkg/holtburger_web.js:20897-20927). wasm physics self-measures elapsed time (loop.js:2808-2816), so a JS shim on performance.now/Date.now virtualizes wasm too.
- **Partial seams already in place:**
  - ?particleClock=sim (index.js:5430-5433; loop.js:3345-3363): the particle/script clock advances by the clamped dt, but never past wall time.
  - time_rng setCurrentTime(fn) and setRng(fn): module-scoped, not on window.
  - ?skytime=<h> pin, or `SessionHandle.setSkyTimeOverride(t)` called per frame (index.html:6318-6340, 6487-6513).
- Workers (bake, texture, shard, keepalive) keep real clocks, which is fine.
- **NOT controllable:** server-driven motion (NPCs, players, projectiles) arrives from ACE in real time.
- **1070 real-time speed (verified, Holtburg, quality=mid, 1280x633):** 22-31 fps, p50 33-42 ms. So real-time 1080p high/ultra at 30/60 fps is not achievable; stepped capture is required for smooth camera moves.

Q5. Resolution
- The agent-mode canvas is min(innerWidth,4096) x min(innerHeight,2160) (index.js:879-897).
- pixelRatio is min(DPR,2) x renderScale, with renderScale in (0,2]. An explicit renderScale pins the value and disables adaptiveRes (:1235-1262).
- `__setRenderScale(n)` changes it live and also resizes the pipeline and clouds (:1268-1286).
- adaptiveRes is off under renderOnDemand, nullRender, an explicit renderScale (:1298-1333) or ?adaptiveRes=off. The debounced resize handler is at :1869.
- **Verified trap:** a 1280,720 window produced a 1280x633 canvas at pr 1 (hbprobe result.json). Use a larger winsize or a viewport override.
- quality:
  - The 1070 does not match GPU_HIGH_RE (quality.js:826), so it auto-selects 'mid'.
  - 'ultra' is never auto-selected. It adds POM 24, statPom, gfxRelief, SSAO, bloom, vignette, aniso 16 and subdiv 8 (:510-543).
- ?msaa defaults to 2 on the composer render targets; 4 or 8 raise it (index.js:817-830).
- clouds=on, and ultra+CSM, have caused context loss 7 times on the 1070 (:5436-5444).
- Live look knobs, after 'ready': `__setExposure`, `__setWorldLightScale`, `__setBloomIntensity`/`Threshold`, `__setVignetteDarkness`/`Offset` (:6323-6362), `__setCloudCoverage`/`Quality`, `__setLightShafts`, `__setSunSize`/`MoonSize`, `__setGameFov`, `__cam.fov(n)`.

hazards.what: Policy: the laptop must not host live client sessions. A quality=high SwiftShader session wedged Chrome's shared GPU process, every GL call then blocked, and Runtime.evaluate timed out browser-wide. Agent-driven live sessions are allowed only when the owner requests that run.
hazards.mitigation: Render film only on the 1070 (MODE2i). Get owner consent per session (memory no-agent-eyetests.md). Parallel agents never start browsers (CLAUDE.md).

hazards.what: Owner presence: watch1070 kills our test Chrome as soon as a person is present, and hbgate.ps1 refuses launches. Test Chrome has also died mid-run on its own. A results file written only at the end (vistest) loses everything.
hazards.mitigation: Write each frame to disk immediately, keep a per-shot manifest, and resume at frame k after relaunch. Run gate1070.sh before every launch and between long steps.

hazards.what: page.screenshot (Page.captureScreenshot) returns stale or black WebGL frames on GPU-composited targets (1070 >10 min stale; T4 black). It also includes DOM HUD.
hazards.mitigation: Capture in-canvas inside the render hook (toDataURL, toBlob or VideoFrame). Use screencast only as a staleness check or preview.

hazards.what: preserveDrawingBuffer=false: canvas pixels are valid only within the task that rendered. A later readback gives zeros or stale data.
hazards.mitigation: Snapshot inside the renderer.render wrapper or a queueMicrotask in the same task. Never read after awaiting a macrotask.

hazards.what: No fixed-dt hook. Stepped frames get dt = min(wall delta, 0.1), so slow captures run the sim up to 3x fast. Private rAF loops (billboards, animated scenery, static particles, VFX bursts) run in wall time between steps, and billboards lag one frame behind the camera.
hazards.mitigation: Install a virtual clock via page.addInitScript before goto (performance.now, Date.now, requestAnimationFrame queue flushed per step; wasm follows through the glue), or add __renderOnce(dt) and clock hooks in code. Never let virtual time run ahead of real time, so web_time liveness and ping logic stay sane.

hazards.what: Server-driven motion (NPCs, players, projectiles, server teleports) arrives from ACE in real time and cannot be stepped. Stepped capture compresses it, because the 1070 renders at about 22-31 fps at mid 1280x633.
hazards.mitigation: Classify shots: stepped for scenery, drone and dungeon fly-throughs; real-time (?targetFps=N plus captureStream/WebCodecs with real timestamps, lower res) for action. Use @attackable off for crowds.

hazards.what: ?syncPhysicsTick is DEFAULT ON (`!== "off"`), so tick is async and __renderOnce returns before the frame has rendered.
hazards.mitigation: Wait as moving_rig.step does (rAF plus vfxGauge.frames change), or capture from the render hook; or pass syncPhysicsTick=off for parked-camera shots.

hazards.what: In-canvas overlays are NOT removed by hud=none: speech bubbles are always on and drawn into the WebGL canvas; the portal tunnel and WORLD_FADEIN overlay are also drawn into the canvas. hb-* DOM HUD is visible in agent-mode since 2026-10-05, so the memory claim that a canvas-element screenshot is HUD-free is stale.
hazards.mitigation: Stub liveScene3d.entityManager.showSpeechBubble during takes. Keep nameplates off (the default). Use ?hud=none for any DOM capture. Use ?portalSpace=off and wait for __isPortalSpaceActive()===false.

hazards.what: Teleport portal space is default ON. The world is not drawn until the destination is ready plus a fade. Under renderOnDemand the tunnel advances only when frames are driven, and stepped capture would record it.
hazards.mitigation: Add ?portalSpace=off to film URLs, or drive __renderOnce until portal space is inactive, then run the settle wait and warm lap.

hazards.what: Before 'ready' (atmosphere bake about 8 s on the 1070) frames use the direct render path (no AP, tone mapping or composer), a different look. Entity lazy compiles finish about 4 s after 'ready'.
hazards.mitigation: Gate on __sceneReadyEverFired, terrainBakedLbs.size>=9 and a settle quiet window (hbprobe settle), then a warm lap.

hazards.what: __cam.set uses lookAt with a fixed up=(0,1,0): gimbal degenerate at ±90° pitch and no roll. capture_canvas_video's pitch-up also looks straight up.

Q1 — WHAT THE ONTOLOGY IS

  - Scale: Tiny/Small/Medium/Large/Massive
  - Category: Structure/Scenery/Furniture/Prop/Creature/NPC/Interactive_*/Sign_Town/Unknown
  - provenance: ClassificationSource, Confidence, ClassificationReason
  - text: Tags[], Name, MaterialTags[], SurfaceIds, ThumbnailPath
  - weenie links: WeenieClassId, WeenieType, ItemType, WeaponType, MaterialType, Level, CreatureType, DifficultyTier, CreatureFamilyName
  - Architecture (Aluvian/Sho/Gharu'ndim/Viamontian/Empyrean/Neutral), Biome[], Behavior

- Built data on disk: /home/wbterminal/projects/RetailSmoke/ontology_cache.jsonl
  - 8,081,019 B, 21,253 lines (15,318 GfxObj + 5,935 Setup), cacheVersion 2, leading UTF-8 BOM, id stored as a decimal number.

- Endpoints:
  - GET /health
  - GET /catalog?filter=
  - POST /command (the body is the flat WBT command; optional timeoutMs, default 120 s; a timeout kills and respawns the child)
  - POST /ticket, GET /tickets
- READ_ALLOW (lines 55-83) includes: info, get-world-info, get-height/heightmap/bulk-heightmap/terrain-data/terrain-layers, terrain-info, list-landblocks, list-objects, describe-landblock, get-dungeon-info, placement-list, get-object-detail, asset-refs, asset-used-by, query-ontology, query-radius, ontology-stats, scene-where-used, get-region, render-preview, get-tile, pvs-visibility-snapshot, the validators, and others.

area: PROJECT CONVENTIONS for holtburger-web: tests/JS gate, suite hygiene, console allowlist, URL-flag lints and docs, lazy-load pattern, service worker/serve.py/shell bundle/modulepreload, Node CLI style, Claude Code skill/agent packaging, git
summary:
Paths below are relative to HB=$REPO/external/holtburger/apps/holtburger-web unless they start with scripts/ (= $REPO/external/holtburger/scripts) or $REPO. I read every file:line cited with verified=true. I ran nothing heavy: no gate, no lint, no browser, no WBT.

Q1. HOW TO ADD TESTS TO THE JS GATE
- Registration is an explicit hand list, not a glob. The gate is `node harness/run-js-headless.mjs` (= `npm test` in package.json; CI runs `node harness/run-js-headless.mjs --quiet`).
- The list is three arrays: TIER1 (lines 99-160), TIER4 (164-197) and TIER5 (215-1037). New suites go at the end of TIER5, before `];` at line 1037, as `{ tier: 5, flag: "<free-text label>", file: "<path relative to the app root>" }`.
  - `flag` is only a label for `--only=` filtering. It is not tied to url-flags.md.
  - Optional `requires: "<path>" | () => path` names an external fixture. If it is absent the row is NO-FIXTURE: not run, and not a pass.
- The COVERAGE GUARD `unregisteredSuites()` (1090-1121) fails the full run (exit 1) for any unregistered file matching these patterns:
  - root `test_*.mjs`
  - `rynth/test_*.mjs`
  - `harness/test_*.mjs`
  - `tests/` files named `test_*` or `*.test.*` with .mjs/.cjs
  - root `test_*.cjs`
  - `harness/glsl_smoke/*_smoke.mjs`
- Root `test_*.cjs` files are by convention headless-Chrome GPU smokes. They must be listed in NEEDS_BROWSER (1073-1085) and must not be in a tier; harness/test_gate_browser_smokes.mjs asserts that. Pure-node CJS tests go in `tests/*.test.cjs`.
- Directories are not scanned recursively. A new `film/` directory, or `tests/film/`, is invisible to the guard, so rot there would go unnoticed. Put suites in `tests/film_<topic>.test.mjs` and helpers in `tests/helpers/`.
- How the runner executes each suite (runOne 1271-1310):
  - a child `node <file>` with cwd = app root, `--max-old-space-size=1536` (HB_TEST_HEAP_MB), 120 s timeout;
  - exit 0 = PASS, non-zero = FAIL;
  - exit 0 plus a SKIP banner (regex 1238-1241, e.g. `X: SKIP —`) = SKIP, which counts as FAIL unless `--allow-skips`;
  - QUARANTINE (1045) must name a real bug.
- The full run takes harness/lib/heavy_lock.mjs: a machine-wide lock at /tmp/hb-heavy.lock plus MemAvailable ≥ 2560 MB. Exit 2 means the lock was refused. A single `node tests/x.test.mjs` takes no lock.
- `--coverage` and `--list` only read directories; they take no lock.
- Rynth has a second runner, `node rynth_test_all_node.cjs`, which globs root `rynth_*_test.cjs`. rynth_ai_client_test.cjs runs only there.
- Test style:
  - plain ESM `.mjs`, `import assert from "node:assert/strict"`;
  - a local `check(name, fn)` / `test()` wrapper printing `[OK]`/`[PASS]`/`[FAIL]`;
  - a final `<suite>: N passed, M failed` line, then `process.exit(1)` or `process.exitCode = 1` on failure;
  - a header comment stating WHY, the flag, DEFAULT OFF/ON, the retail decomp cites, and `Run: node tests/x.test.mjs (from apps/holtburger-web/)`.
- Stubbing three.js:
  - Real `three` 0.184.0 is in node_modules (`import * as THREE from "three"` or `await import("three")`). Prefer it: real Quaternion/Matrix/slerp math works in Node.
  - `harness/lib/locate_three.mjs` `requireThree()` treats a missing three as FAIL.
  - `_three_stub.mjs` is a tracked minimal stub (Vector3/Quaternion with no methods, Object3D, Mesh…). `_three_stub_loader.mjs` is a Node resolve hook. Install with `register(pathToFileURL(resolve(__dirname,"../_three_stub_loader.mjs")).href)` before importing app modules (tests/carnage_hit_guard.test.mjs:26-31).
- Stubbing window: `globalThis.window = { location: { search: "" }, … }` before the import. For DOM, use the hand-rolled fake DOMs in tests/helpers/ (`installFakeDom`, etc.); there is no jsdom.
- For modules that cannot load headless:
  - `harness/lib/import_edited.mjs` `importEdited(relPath, edit)` loads the real module with a one-line test seam;
  - `harness/lib/splice_module.mjs` plus `harness/lib/scene3d_stubs.mjs` splice it into `new Function`.

Q2. RULES NEW FILES MUST SATISFY
- (a) Suite hygiene (harness/test_suite_hygiene.mjs, shrink-only ratchet against harness/source-pin-baseline.json, 31 entries).
  - A new suite that reads app source text (fs read of a scene3d/ app/ src/ plugins/ ui/ rynth/ path or index.html) without importing or executing app code is PURE-PIN, and that fails.
  - New suites must EXECUTE shipped code.
- (b) Console allowlist (harness/lib/console_allowlist.mjs plus harness/test_console_allowlist.mjs).
  - Zero console errors / pageerrors in browser runs, after subtracting ALLOWLIST (one entry: QuickEmote 0x13).
  - A new entry needs id, regex pattern, `evidence` with a file:line or `docs/` cite (EVIDENCE_RE line 83), and `added: YYYY-MM-DD`.
  - Film-mode code must not console.error in normal operation.
- (c) scripts/lint-url-flags.mjs (CI).
  - Sweeps scene3d/** + app/** + index.html for `URLSearchParams…get("x")` within ±10 lines of URLSearchParams/location.search, plus regex `[?&]x=` readers.
  - Fails on OFF-SPELLING (`!== "off"` when the docs row promises 0/false) and on PRESENCE-GUARD / DIVERGENT.
  - UNDOCUMENTED is advisory unless `--strict`. scripts/net-review/ci-smoke.sh:43 does run `--strict`.
- (d) scripts/audit-flag-defaults.mjs (CI).
  - Sweeps scene3d, app, index.html, plugins, rynth, netbrain.
  - Hard-fails when the docs Default-cell polarity mismatches the reader, and when an in-code comment within 6 lines above the reader says "default OFF" while the reader resolves ON (or the reverse).
- (e) scripts/lint-harness-params.mjs (ci-smoke L3). Any `?param=` emitted by harness/**, scripts/multi-agent/**, net-review/** or perf-worker/** must have a JS reader or a url-flags.md row.
- (f) scripts/lint-event-consumers.mjs (CI).
  - Plugin-bus handlers must read `ev.detail` (DETAIL-UNREAD fails `(p)=>p.guid`).
  - A newly emitted bus name needs a subscriber or an EXTENSION_POINTS entry.
- (g) docs/url-flags.md rows are parsed by `^\| \`flag\`(=…)? \|`. Rows must start at column 0; blockquoted `> |` rows are invisible to the lints.
  - Main-table format: `| Flag | Values | Default | Reader (semantics when absent) | Effect | Where |`, e.g. §1 header at line 220, §4 Dev/debug at 504, §5 Login/automation at 661.
  - §0 (lines 3-61) is a BLOCKQUOTED adjudication table: `> | Flag | Why it is OFF | Evidence that would flip it | Status |`. Every deliberately default-OFF flag gets a §0 row. Film mode fits the "Harness / boot contract params" class (row 54).
  - Newer dated `### YYYY-MM-DD — …` sections use a 4-column `| Flag | What it does | Eye-test | Pass criteria |` table (1682-1687) with `\`flag\`=on (default **OFF**)` in the first cell. audit-flag-defaults then reads the Eye-test cell as Default, so prefer the 6-column main-table row.
  - Escape literal `|` inside cells as `\|`.
- (h) File naming: suites as above. No new Worker sites without updating WORKER_ENTRIES (scripts/build-shell.mjs:101-107), or the shell build throws. No SharedWorker.

Q3. LAZY-LOAD PATTERN AND FLAG READING
- House reader grammar: an exported, injectable, optionally memoised reader. Examples:
  - scene3d/selection_lighting.js:81-93 `selectionFlashEnabled(search)`: `new URLSearchParams(q).get("selectionFlash") === "on"`, try/catch → false, and a `_set…ForTest` hook. Tested at tests/selection_lighting.test.mjs:272-279 against `""`, `?x`, `?x=1`, `?x=true`, `?x=ON`, `?x=off` → all false.
  - scene3d/residency_grid.js:67-78 `slotGridEnabled(search)`: on/1/true/yes allowlist.
  - Keep the comparison on the same line as `.get()` (residency_grid.js:58) so audit-flag-defaults classifies it.
- The footgun: `!== "off"` means ABSENT ⇒ ON. Only an exact match (`=== "on"` or `=== "1"`) is a real opt-in (docs/url-flags.md:79-80). `=== "off"` over a true default is also ON.
- Zero-cost lazy-import examples:
  - (1) scene3d/index.js:4429-4444: right after `window.liveScene3d = liveScene3d` (4420), `if (new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("dismember") !== "off") import("./dismember.js").then(m=>m.installDismemberDiag()).catch(err=>console.warn("[dismember] failed to load:",err))`, and the same for carnage. This is the right placement and shape, but those flags are default-ON; film mode needs `=== "on"`.
  - (2) rynth/bot.js:1100-1103: `if (new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("thoughtOverlay") === "1") import(\`${base}/ai/thought_overlay.js\`).then(...).catch(e=>console.warn(...))`. This is a strict opt-in; the module is never statically imported and never preloaded.
- Counter-example (not zero cost despite its comment): index.html:2476-2483 `?packSource` (and the geomBundles block at 2664-2676) does `await import("./scene3d/pack_fetch_controller.js")` only when on. But scripts/gen-modulepreload.mjs seeds literal dynamic imports from index.html AND every app/*.js (lines 97-117), so the module is in the modulepreload block (index.html:1226) and is fetched and parsed on every boot.
  - Rule: put the flag-gated `import("./film/…")` inside a scene3d module (the crawl follows static imports only), not in index.html or app/.
  - app/ is wrong for lazy-only code anyway: harness/test_build_shell.mjs:254-256 asserts every app/*.js is modulepreloaded.
  - Making a film module statically reachable from the boot graph changes the pinned `NON_APP_PRELOADS = 402` (test_build_shell.mjs:345-346). That needs a gen-modulepreload re-run plus a hand-edited pin bump.

Q4. SERVING, SERVICE WORKER AND SHELL FOR NEW FILES
- serve.py serves the whole external/holtburger tree (Handler directory=HOLT_ROOT, 658-683) with `Cache-Control: no-cache` for .js/.mjs (836-888). New files are served with no registration.
- The service worker never intercepts JS/HTML/wasm/manifest.json. It only touches `/shards/` (CAS), `boot.hba`, `manifest/*.bin` (bake-gated) and `/scene3d/assets/` (stale-while-revalidate) (service-worker.js:197-225, 442-444, 459-463). New JS dirs need no SW listing.
  - Film assets placed under scene3d/assets/ would become stale-while-revalidate.
  - The MEMORY note that the SW caches index.html is contradicted by the current code. `?nosw=1` still applies (index.html:2349).
- The bundled shell is the real constraint. scripts/build-shell.mjs stages only `BUNDLED_DIRS = ["scene3d","plugins","ui","rynth","app"]` (109; walkFiles at 138 is recursive), then runs esbuild with `--bundle` and no splitting.
  - A literal import of a top-level `film/` module from bundled code cannot resolve in the staged tree. I expect esbuild to error; that esbuild behaviour is unverified.
  - harness/test_build_shell.mjs runs the real build twice when /mnt/wbterminal2/reeng/T11/bin/esbuild exists (it does locally). On CI it is NO-FIXTURE.
  - shell-manifest.json is generated and gitignored (510 inputs). Its `inputs` going stale only makes the proxy serve unbundled until its background rebuild. Nothing has to list new files by hand.
- Use `scene3d/film/` (subdirectory precedent: scene3d/motion, particles, vfx, audio, diag). It is bundled, swept by both flag lints, the event lint and hygiene, and served.
- Import stateful scene3d modules carefully. scene3d/index.js imports `./terrain.js?v=phase-d-batch`, `./buildings.js?v=phase-d-batch` and `./statics.js?v=phase7-par` (38/49/54), and index.html imports `./scene3d/index.js?v=diag-followons-2026-05-23` (3868). A different specifier gives a second module instance on the unbundled arm. Inject dependencies, or use `window.liveScene3d`.

Q5. CLAUDE CODE PACKAGING
- The only existing skill is worldbuilder-terminal, kept as two separate identical copies (cmp: identical), not symlinks:
  - ~/.claude/skills/worldbuilder-terminal/SKILL.md (31,121 B, plus on-demand companion commands.md, plus evals/evals.json `{skill_name, evals:[{id,name,prompt,…}]}` and evals/trigger-eval.json `[{query, should_trigger}]`, the skill-creator format);
  - $REPO/.claude/skills/worldbuilder-terminal/skill.md (lowercase, git-tracked).
- Frontmatter uses only `name` and `description` (~/.claude/skills/discord-list/SKILL.md has the same two).
- No agents directory exists in ~/.claude or $REPO/.claude.
- The user's usual cwd is /home/wbterminal, so ~/.claude is both user and project scope there. Install:
  - the skill at ~/.claude/skills/film-mode/SKILL.md;
  - the agent at ~/.claude/agents/<name>.md (frontmatter name/description/tools/model: opus; this field set is from Claude Code knowledge, not read on disk).
- Keep the canonical copy versioned at $REPO/.claude/skills/film-mode/SKILL.md (uppercase) and $REPO/.claude/agents/<name>.md, and symlink the ~/.claude paths to them to avoid drift. Whether a lowercase `skill.md` is discovered is unverified.
- `.claude/worktrees/` is gitignored; `.claude/skills` and `.claude/agents` would be tracked.
- ~/CLAUDE.md requires the laptop resource rules to be copied verbatim into every agent prompt. The MEMORY note requires agent briefs to forbid pushing and self-armed git automation.
- ~/.claude/settings.json PreToolUse hooks block Write/Edit and Bash redirects into memory/.
- Enabled plugins include chrome-devtools-mcp and skill-creator.
- Per the relayed user note: the agent is the Claude Code session on the Opus subscription. No Anthropic SDK, API key or API call goes in code. Only the JEV/OpenRouter client makes API calls.

Q6. NODE CLI AND COMMIT CONVENTIONS
- CLIs:
  - ESM `.mjs` with `#!/usr/bin/env node` and a long WHY/WHAT/USAGE header;
  - hand-rolled argv parsing, never node:util parseArgs. `--key=value` via `arg(k, default)` (harness/moving-bench.mjs:126-133; scripts/multi-agent/fleet.mjs:35-46), or `--key value` (tools/clip-alpha-gate.mjs:424-434);
  - an exported `main()` behind an importable main-guard `if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(path.resolve(process.argv[1])).href) main().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(2)})` (clip-alpha-gate.mjs:543-548; test_suite_hygiene.mjs:584);
  - exit codes 0 = ok, 1 = finding/failure, 2 = usage/env/lock refused (moving-bench adds 3 = ratchet regression).
- `.cjs` is used only for legacy capture_*.cjs scripts and the rynth_*_test.cjs suites.
- Browser drivers:
  - Do `await acquireHeavyLock({label})`, then `const {chromium}=await import("playwright-core")`, then `chromium.connectOverCDP(CDP)` to an already-running Chrome, then `page.evaluate` (moving-bench.mjs:447-453).
  - lib/boot.mjs `launchAndEnter` forces `nullRender=1` (68-81), so it is useless for filming.
  - Prior-art recorder: capture_canvas_video.cjs (MediaRecorder + canvas.captureStream → .webm, RECORD_* env knobs, @teleloc waypoints).
- Git: external/holtburger is NOT a submodule. There is no .gitmodules, no .git inside it, and `git -C external/holtburger rev-parse --show-toplevel` returns $REPO. It is vendored in the parent repo on branch master (in sync with origin/master), so there are no submodule bumps.
- Commit style:
  - subject `<area>: <plain-English user-visible outcomes, comma/em-dash list>`, where area is mostly `holtburger-web`, also `holtburger`, `holtburger docs`, `holtburger tools`;
  - body: a prose paragraph, then `- ` bullets wrapped near 100 columns, then "Still to do…", then `Tests: N new gate suites; full JS gate X/Y …` or `Gate: JS 695/0, rynth node 68/0/32, … lints clean`, plus a docs/HANDOFF-<topic>-YYYY-MM-DD.md pointer;
  - trailer `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>`; author salvia420-bit.
- CI is $REPO/.github/workflows/holtburger-ci.yml, with path filter `external/holtburger/**`. Its js job runs npm ci, run-js-headless --quiet, gen-client-event-kinds --check, lint-url-flags, lint-event-consumers and audit-flag-defaults.

Also notable: `?hud=none` (index.html:614 adds `no-hud`; CSS 527-539 hides every overlay except #stage), `?plugins=none` (app/plugin_bar.js:476-485) and `?camDebug=on` → `window.__cam` free-camera rig with park() (scene3d/camera.js:463-470, 1440-1531) are existing default-inert hooks for HUD-free shots. rynth/ai/llm_client.js (frozen interface) is the in-tree OpenRouter transport, and rynth_ai_client_test.cjs is the template for mocking the provider with an in-process http server.

apis.name: run-js-headless (the JS gate)
apis.what: Explicit-list runner over TIER1 (99), TIER4 (164) and TIER5 (215-1037). Each suite runs as a child node process with cwd = app root and a 1536 MB heap cap. Exit 0 = pass. A SKIP banner fails by default. Exit 1 on FAIL or UNREGISTERED; exit 2 when the heavy lock is refused. Also `npm test` (package.json). --coverage and --list take no lock.

apis.name: unregisteredSuites() coverage guard
apis.what: SCAN patterns (1098-1110): root test_*.mjs, rynth/test_*.mjs, harness/test_*.mjs, tests/(test_*|*.test.*).(mjs|cjs), root test_*.cjs (browser smokes) and harness/glsl_smoke/*_smoke.mjs. Not recursive. A file matching these that is in no tier, QUARANTINE, NEEDS_TOOLCHAIN or NEEDS_BROWSER fails the full run.

apis.name: TIER5 registration entry
apis.signature: { tier: 5, flag: "<label>", file: "tests/<name>.test.mjs", requires?: string | () => string }
apis.what: Append new suites before the closing `];` at 1037. `requires` names an external fixture path (absent = NO-FIXTURE, not run), e.g. harness_build_shell at 652-653 requires the esbuild binary.

apis.name: NEEDS_BROWSER list
apis.what: Headless-Chromium GPU smokes are listed here and never run by the Node gate (orchestrator only, via `capped-build node <file>`, one tab). harness/test_gate_browser_smokes.mjs asserts it names exactly the on-disk root test_*.cjs and glsl_smoke files and that none of them is in the plan.

apis.name: classifySuite (suite-hygiene PURE-PIN detector)
apis.signature: export function classifySuite(src, suiteRel?) -> {pin, reads, executes, reimplement}
apis.what: Shrink-only ratchet against harness/source-pin-baseline.json (31 files). A new suite that reads app source (scene3d/app/src/plugins/ui/rynth/index.html) and executes no app code fails. HB_REGEN_SOURCE_PIN=1 can only shrink the baseline.

apis.name: console allowlist
apis.what: Zero-console-error bar for browser runs. Entries need id, regex pattern, evidence with a file:line or docs/ cite (EVIDENCE_RE line 83) and an ISO added date. Linted by harness/test_console_allowlist.mjs.

apis.name: acquireHeavyLock / acquireHeavyLockSync / childHeapArgs
apis.signature: export async function acquireHeavyLock(opts:{label}) ; export function acquireHeavyLockSync(opts) (357); export function childHeapArgs(env) (95)
apis.what: Machine-wide mkdir lock at /tmp/hb-heavy.lock that also waits for MemAvailable >= HB_MIN_FREE_MB (2560). Re-entrant; bypassed by CI=true, HB_HEAVY_LOCK=0 or HB_HEAVY_LOCK_HELD. Every Chrome-driving film CLI must take it.

apis.name: requireThree
apis.signature: export async function requireThree(suiteLabel) -> THREE namespace
apis.what: The one sanctioned way to load real three in headless suites. A missing three is FAIL (exit 1), not SKIP. Bare `import * as THREE from "three"` also works (node_modules three 0.184.0).

apis.name: importEdited
apis.signature: export async function importEdited(relPath, edit:(src)=>string, salt?) -> module namespace
apis.what: Loads the real app module as a data: ESM with a one-line test seam edited in. Dependencies stay genuine (one three, one materials.js). Throws if the edit does not change the source.

apis.name: spliceModule / stripStaticImports / stripExports + scene3d stubs
apis.signature: export function spliceModule(src, opts); stripStaticImports(src) (66); stripExports(src) (73); scene3d_stubs.mjs: MATERIALS_JS_STUBS (18), entitiesToplevelPrelude(except) (149), entitiesCtorPrelude() (165)
apis.what: Lift functions out of modules that cannot load headless into new Function, with a centralised narrow stub map. Use only when import or importEdited is impossible.

apis.name: three stub resolve hook
apis.signature: export async function resolve(specifier, context, nextResolve) // maps "three" -> _three_stub.mjs
apis.what: Install with `register(pathToFileURL(resolve(__dirname,"../_three_stub_loader.mjs")).href)` before app imports (tests/carnage_hit_guard.test.mjs:26-31). The stub's Quaternion has no methods, so camera-math tests need real three.

apis.name: lint-url-flags

- Server-side sequence:

5) STREAMING RADIUS / UPDATE RATES
- ACE visible set:
  - Outdoors: the current landblock plus 8 adjacent landblocks' server objects (ObjectMaint.cs:352; LandblockManager.cs:577), excluding objects inside EnvCells that are not SeenOutside.
  - Dungeons (all heights 0 + EnvCells) have no adjacent landblocks (:581). The set is the current cell plus its VisibleCells PVS, plus outdoor objects if the cell is SeenOutside (ObjectMaint.cs:370-385).
  - Objects that leave visibility go to a 25 s DestructionQueue (ObjectMaint.cs:21).
  - Landblocks go dormant after 1 min without players and unload after 5 min (Entity/Landblock.cs:113/118). Spawned extras vanish when that happens.
  - Speech/emote text range is 96 m (WorldObject.cs:1018).
- Client: collision heightmaps for the 3x3 landblock ring around the PLAYER (app/landblock_stream.js:722). Streaming is player-centric (world_stream via the local player's position updates).
- Rates:
  - Awake or returning monsters: SendUpdatePosition every Monster_Tick of 0.2 s (Monster_Tick.cs:10; Monster_Navigation.cs:251-263), plus MoveTo UpdateMotion.
  - Idle creatures and NPCs: no updates.
  - Players: AutonomousPosition heartbeat 1 s with a change gate of 0.05 m / 0.0035 rad (holtburger-core movement/common.rs:27, system.rs:451-462). ACE re-broadcasts if RequestedLocationBroadcast is set or at least 1 s has passed (Player_Tick.cs:403/513).

- Tracking shots should follow the rendered root (entityMap.get(guid).root.position, AC world x=lbX*192+lx; acToThree(x,y,z)=[x,z,-y] in adapter.js:1817), not objectPosition (the raw wire pose). Add camera-side damping to absorb correction snaps every 0.2-1 s.

Then turnToHeading. Do not capture frames while the tunnel owns the frame.

seams.what: Film-owned hide producer in the entity visibility composite
seams.filmUse: Add an inst._filmHidden term in _applyEntityVisible so kind=17 flips (teleport Hidden on/off) cannot un-hide the local rig. Hiding via root.visible also drops shadows and held items. Keep @cloak as the server half.
Gate EntityManager.showSpeechBubble (in-canvas sprites, always on, not covered by ?hud=none) behind a film flag or caption policy.

Footage is rendered by this one client, so em.setMotion/setSwingMotion on any guid (NPC extras included) gives reliable, instant direction. Use server @animation when the pose must persist against server motion updates.

Spawn with @createliveops wcid n lifespan, collect guids from __pluginClient.world 'objectCreated' (or a nearbyEntityGuids + objectWcid diff), target with requestAppraisal(guid) + queryHealth(guid), then direct with @animation Cmd guid / @turnto / @pscript and remove with @delete.

Shot plan sets __pluginClient.sky.setTimeOverride(t) and setDayOverride(d,y) (DayGroup chosen via calc_present_day_group), then calls retailLightTick.reset(). Optional __setWeather({is_storm}) with ?clouds=on, __environFogOverride=environFogFor(n), or server @setlbenviron.

seams.what: Movement for the player-actor and the camera carrier
seams.filmUse: Walk paths with moveToPosition/turnToHeading/setMovementInput (RynthWebHost capability table already wraps them), keeping the cloaked player within about 1 landblock of the subject so ACE (landblock + 8 adjacent / PVS) and client streaming keep the scene populated.

TOWNS ns/ew feed @tele; '@telepoi list' (parse the chat reply) feeds named jumps; WbtOracle (:8768) answers get-height, describe-landblock and ontology queries for @teleloc z and site metadata. rynth/unwedge.js:584 shows the proven @teleloc string format.

Aim at liveScene3d.entityManager.entityMap.get(guid).root.position (rendered pose, wasm-interpolated through applyManagedPose) and apply critically damped smoothing. Avoid the raw objectPosition, which snaps on 0.2-1 s server updates.

When the film camera sits in a different EnvCell than the player, call resolveViewerCell then setViewerCell so the portal and render-set walks root at the camera. Use the clipCameraToCellSpace and sweepSphereAgainst* sweeps for obstruction.
window.__cam.park()/set() already suspends the follow camera, but it uses lookAt with up (0,1,0), which flips near pitch ±90°. Film mode's camera should own the quaternion (slerp) instead.

hazards.what: sendChat('/telepoi X') is SPOKEN publicly: ACE parses only '@'. The d.ts doc claims '/' also works.
hazards.mitigation: Always send '@cmd', or use __routeSlashCommand (which resolves soul emotes first).

hazards.what: @teleloc does no z or dungeon-cell correction and silently returns on any unparsable float. A wrong z lands you in mid-air or underground; a wrong EnvCell lands you in black space.
hazards.mitigation: Prefer @tele (server z) outdoors and @telepoi/@teledungeon for dungeons. Take @teleloc tuples from recorded getLocalPlayerPose or terrainHeightAt/WBT get-height; @nudge fixes the cell.

hazards.what: @telexyz takes the cell in DECIMAL with quaternion order qx qy qz qw, unlike @teleloc (hex cell, qw first).
hazards.mitigation: Standardize on @teleloc.

hazards.what: @tele needs N/S first (regex) and gives identity rotation. In dungeon-only landblocks terrain z is 0, a void. A single-word @teledungeon argument is parsed as a hex landblock first.
hazards.mitigation: Use '@tele 42.1n 33.6e' style and follow with turnToHeading. Use landblock hex for @teledungeon.

hazards.what: Every teleport plays the portal-space tunnel, at least ~4 s after arrival (CONTINUE ≥2 s, 1 s fade-out, 1 s fade-in; failsafes 6 s and 20 s). The world is not drawn meanwhile. Server CreateObjects for the destination arrive 1 s after the teleport, so entities pop in.
hazards.mitigation: Treat teleports as edit cuts. Pause capture from portalSpaceEntered until portalSpaceExited plus a settle delay. ?portalSpace=off keeps the world visible but shows streaming pop-in.

hazards.what: @cloak on does NOT stop monster aggro (cloak never clears Attackable).
hazards.mitigation: Also send @attackable off, and optionally @neversaydie.

hazards.what: Client-side hiding via setVisibility(localGuid,false) is overwritten by the next kind=17 event (each teleport flips Hidden on and off). Opacity fade (setLocalPlayerCameraOpacity 0) still casts shadows, and camera.js pushes opacity 1.0 when it leaves the near band.
hazards.mitigation: Add a film-owned visibility producer, or re-assert after each portalSpaceExited. Keep @cloak on as the server half.

hazards.what: Hidden player can still emit light from a held light source (pool-fed lights are not tied to root.visible except for projectiles).
hazards.mitigation: Unwield torches and lights on the film character.

hazards.what: In-canvas speech bubbles (NPC chatter, emote text) appear in footage. They are always on and not gated by ?hud=none; the portal tunnel is in-canvas too.
hazards.mitigation: Add a film gate in EntityManager.showSpeechBubble. Avoid triggering NPC speech.

hazards.what: The 'Always daylight outdoors' option (CharacterOption 0x05) re-pins setSkyTimeOverride(0.5) every 250 ms. A ?skytime URL pin disables that driver.
hazards.mitigation: Turn the option off on the film character (setCharacterOption(5,false)) or boot with ?skytime=...

hazards.what: The sky override is lost on relog (populateSkyDescFromRegion makes a new evaluator at every EnteredWorld). Ground lighting lags up to 15 s after a time jump.
hazards.mitigation: Re-assert after every EnteredWorld and call retailLightTick.reset() after each time change.

hazards.what: The moon/star clock (getSkyPortalTicks → sky_game_date.js) ignores setSkyTimeOverride, so night shots may show a moon and stars inconsistent with the pinned sun time.
hazards.mitigation: Eye-check night shots on the 1070; a film-side date override may be needed (camera/sky agent).

hazards.what: No server time or DayGroup control. Rain/snow/lightning particle systems were removed (2026-08-01); 'weather' is DayGroup sky objects plus volumetric clouds plus fog.
hazards.mitigation: Use setGameDayOverride + __setWeather + ?clouds=on. Note CharacterOption 0x04 (disable weather) drops the rain/snow sky objects.

hazards.what: Dead or forbidden admin verbs: @freeze/@unfreeze are no-op TODOs, @createcreature is commented out, @location is a stub, @movetome is Admin-only, @morph logs you out, @portalstorm 2 teleports you to 0x7F7F001C. @rotate, @nudge (content version) and @createinst write ace_world SQL (permanent content edits).
hazards.mitigation: Whitelist film verbs: tele*, cloak, attackable, create/createliveops, animation, turnto, pscript, effect, delete, setlbenviron, run, neversaydie.

hazards.what: @delete removes HealthQueryTarget first, then ManaQueryTarget, then CurrentAppraisalTarget. A stale selection deletes the wrong object (players are protected).
hazards.mitigation: Call queryHealth(guid) (or queryHealth(0)) and requestAppraisal(guid) right before @delete, or prefer @createliveops lifespans.

hazards.what: @create returns no guid. Multiple spawns go to the same spot (physics placement may drop some). Extras persist until the landblock unloads (5 min with no players); a dormant landblock (1 min) stops ticking.
hazards.mitigation: Capture guids via objectCreated or a nearbyEntityGuids diff. Use @createliveops lifespans and spawn in batches.

hazards.what: pollEntityUpdates, poll_events and pollRemotePoses are destructive drains; pursuitStatus is read-clear. Film code that calls them steals renderer, nav or bot events.
hazards.mitigation: Observe via __pluginClient events, entityMap reads or __chatHooks only. Don't run film nav beside the rynth bot or picking monitor.

hazards.what: @animation uses case-sensitive MotionCommand names and sets ForwardCommand. Whether the LOCAL rig applies a server UpdateMotion aimed at self is unverified. The soul-emote spam guard drops a repeat of the same emote within its animation length.
hazards.mitigation: Direct the player via the soul-emote path (local prediction plus broadcast). Use @animation or client setMotion for NPCs.

hazards.what: Streaming is player-centric. ACE sends objects only from the player's landblock + 8 adjacent (outdoors) or the PVS (dungeons, no adjacent). The client heightmap ring is 3x3 around the player. A drone camera far from the cloaked player sees an empty or partial world.
hazards.mitigation: Move the cloaked player with the shot (walk or teleport near the subject). Keep the camera within about 1 landblock of the player, and wait for the 1 s CreateObject delay after a teleport.

hazards.what: Single-login accounts: relaunch needs a ~25 s gap or both sessions get 'Account In Use' kicks. The stream-soak bot also uses tailnet1.
hazards.mitigation: Use a dedicated Developer-level film account; account creation is an owner decision.

hazards.what: terrainHeightAt and portal readiness only work for landblocks resident on this client (near the player).
hazards.mitigation: For distant @teleloc z use WBT get-height via WbtOracle, or @tele's server-derived z.

recommendations: Build film world-control as a pure in-page JS module behind ?film=on (default OFF). Its only entry points are window.__sessionHandle, __pluginClient (sky, movement, events, world), liveScene3d.entityManager, __chatHooks and __routeSlashCommand. The Claude Code session drives it over CDP Runtime.evaluate with no Anthropic API and no wasm rebuild for v1.

Film setup sequence after __bootState==='ready': '@cloak on', '@attackable off', '@neversaydie on', optionally '@run on'; setCharacterOption(5,false) (always-daylight off); boot with ?hud=none&agent=1&camDebug=on.

Teleport policy: outdoor exterior sites use '@tele <ns>n|s <ew>e|w' (server z, building-aware; convert with ew = gx/240-101.95, ns = gy/240-101.95). Towns and dungeon entrances use '@telepoi <name>'. Dungeon starts use '@teledungeon <lbhex>'. Exact re-framing uses '@teleloc 0xCELL x y z qw qx qy qz' with tuples recorded from getLocalPlayerPose. Always follow with the portal-space readiness chain and turnToHeading.

Treat every teleport as an edit cut and stop capture across the tunnel. For continuous moves (dolly, tracking, dungeon fly-through) walk the cloaked carrier player with moveToPosition/setMovementInput and keep the camera within about 1 landblock of it.

Add a film-owned visibility term (inst._filmHidden) to _applyEntityVisible (entities.js:2972) and a film gate in showSpeechBubble (entities.js:7154). Both are small JS edits with targeted node tests only.

Actor direction: the player uses __routeSlashCommand(handle,'/<soul emote token>') (catalog in ACE Entity/SoulEmote.cs). NPC extras use client em.setMotion/setSwingMotion for instant control, or '@animation <MotionCommandName> <guidhex>' for server-persistent poses. Facing: position the player, then requestAppraisal(guid) + '@turnto'.

Extras: '@createliveops <wcid> <n> <lifespan_s>'; collect guids from __pluginClient.world 'objectCreated'; remove with queryHealth(guid)+requestAppraisal(guid)+'@delete'. Pick wcids from the LSD weenie_summary or the live ace_world.

Time and weather plan per shot: setSkyTimeOverride(t) plus retailLightTick.reset(); DayGroup via setGameDayOverride(day,year), solving calc_present_day_group offline per target index; optional __setWeather({is_storm}) with ?clouds=on on the 1070; fog via __environFogOverride=environFogFor(n) (client-only) rather than server @setlbenviron (which persists and delays teleports by 1 s).

Give JEV typed enums only: POI names (from '@telepoi list'), SoulEmote tokens, MotionCommand names, EnvironChangeType ids, DayGroup indices and sky t. The agent turns JEV choices into the commands above.
Optional later (one orchestrated wasm build): expose GameAction AdvocateTeleport (0xD6) as SessionHandle.advocateTeleport(cell,x,y,z) for exact x,y with server-derived z inside buildings.
Subject tracking must read entityMap.get(guid).root.position (rendered, interpolated) with critically damped camera smoothing, not objectPosition.
Do not call pollEntityUpdates, poll_events, pollRemotePoses or pursuitStatus from film code, and do not run film mode alongside the rynth bot (?bot=1).
openQuestions: Live check needed: does @cloak on actually hide the LOCAL rig on our client (SetState NoDraw|Cloaked → kind=17 → setVisibility(localGuid,false))? The code chain implies yes.
Does the local rig play a server UpdateMotion aimed at self (e.g. '@animation SitState' with no guid), or is that path suppressed for the local player?
What is the film account's real access level? Memory says tailnet1 = Developer. Admin-only verbs such as @movetome would need a set-accountaccess decision by the owner.
Retail Dereth DayGroup names and order: daygroup_weather.js assumes an inferred 20-entry order. A WBT/DAT Region SkyDesc dump is needed to map 'rainy/snowy/stormy' requests to indices reliably.
Should film mode keep portal space on (clean black cut) or use ?portalSpace=off (world visible, streaming pop-in) between shots?
Does the holtburger client cull known objects that left server visibility (ACE expects the client to cull after the 25 s DestructionTime), or do stale extras linger in the entityMap?
Do monster extras with @attackable off stay put, or do some creature emote scripts make them wander out of frame?
How far do the takram far-terrain ring and object residency draw around the player? This decides the maximum drone altitude and distance (render/camera agent's area).
